verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection service that stores merchant order data, so data region/residency choice is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no mention of selectable storage regions or residency controls. The sensitive-data rejection layer is an adjacent privacy control, not residency, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
